label: SCG I.22 joined distinct principles fall under the dependence trilemma
paraphrase: OPEN analyst coarsening of SCG I.22 n.2's dilemma and consonance trilemma, attribution deferred: at a selected world, for every esse e joined to a represented principle q distinct from e, either some s other than e is such that e depends absolutely on s or the joining of e to q depends on s (horns (i) and (ii), only in what they share, with n.3's conjunction refinement), or q depends on e (horn (iii)). The repugnance branch is omitted because a joined pair is one to which the esse belongs. This coverage claim is exactly what a co-fundamental union of distinct principles denies.
